prompt: A team task tracker: sign-up and sign-in, workspaces with roles (owner, member, guest), projects with tasks, assignees, due dates and comments, a REST API, a responsive web UI with a board view, email-style notifications stored in the database, CSV export, and an admin page; SQLite; with tests for the API and the UI.

org.sizing: Balanced: one web app with three distinct parts (the API and data, the web UI, and its visual system), so three makers flat under me, and I do the one final review.

plan.goal: Build Teamboard, a team task tracker: sign-up and sign-in, workspaces with owner/member/guest roles, projects with tasks, assignees, due dates and comments, a documented REST API, a responsive React web UI with a drag-and-drop board, email-style notifications stored in SQLite, CSV export and a site admin page, with API tests (Vitest) and UI tests (Playwright).
